items.escena: A clay teenage girl walking her dog along the same tree-lined street at sunrise, a path worn smooth in the grass from many earlier morning walks
A clay student putting a folded umbrella into her backpack beside a window full of grey rain clouds, getting ready before she leaves for school
A clay boy calmly riding a crowded city bus at dawn, relaxed and half asleep with headphones, while a newcomer beside him clutches the pole looking nervous
A clay student settling into her usual seat by the classroom window, the cushion worn into her shape, placing the same green notebook on the desk as every day
A clay diorama split in two halves: on the left a boy in school uniform hurrying out of the door with a backpack, on the right the same boy relaxing in a hammock in casual clothes
A clay student boarding a yellow school bus at the start of a long winding country road that disappears toward a small school building on a distant hill
A clay teenage boy sitting up in bed, stretching his arms and yawning, as morning sunlight pours through the window onto his messy hair
A clay girl in pajamas pulling a blanket up to her chin and switching off a bedside lamp, a crescent moon glowing through the window
A clay Mexican family seated around a kitchen table sharing a meal of eggs, beans, tortillas and orange juice in warm morning light
Clay students with backpacks and workers with bags stepping onto a busy city bus at an early morning stop, while others cycle and walk past along the road
A clay exchange student in a big puffy coat taking careful, wobbly steps on a snowy sidewalk, slowly finding her balance while a local girl walks beside her encouragingly
A clay grandfather napping in the same armchair every afternoon, a folded blanket over his knees and his hat resting exactly where it always does on the side table
